summary: Frontend-only test of /netapp-portfolio changes at 1920x900 (per-array specs, backup section, moved data-reduction calculator, configurator result) plus /robocze regression. Every requested check passed. No runtime overlay and zero console errors on either page.

issues: AFF A20, A30 and A50 (and the matching ASA models, lines 32/44/56/106/118/130 in netappModels.js) all show 'Raw (1 macierz) 4.0 PB', but their drive limits are 48/72/120. 48 drives x 30.72 TB is about 1.5 PB, so 4.0 PB on A20/A30 does not match the drive count for a single HA pair. Check against NetApp Hardware Universe.

For C-Series with cloud=YES, the 'Dlaczego' list shows two near-duplicate FabricPool reasons ('FabricPool tier do S3/Azure — hybrid cloud' and 'FabricPool: tiering danych zimnych do public cloud'). Cause: recommendModel() adds a FabricPool reason inside the CFLASH branch and again in the generic cloud check (also duplicated for AFF).

action_items: Remove duplicate FabricPool reasons in recommendModel() (CFLASH/AFF branch vs. generic cloud check)
Check maxRaw for AFF/ASA A20/A30 (4.0 PB) against their max drive counts
